cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought the same sandwiches as our last picnic. Set the blanket on dry ground, please; we can get this arranged properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our last picnic was when you said we needed space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There is more space under that tree. Move the basket first, then the blanket; don't drag crumbs into the grass.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep the blanket here. Open the mustard jar, please. You said a level teaspoon last time; check this before I spread it.

reason: Make precise picnic corrections the active diversions from B relationship question, with refusal to move causing food-preparation redirection.
